summary_1line: Surya warns Karna that Indra will beg for his divine armor and earrings, but Karna insists on giving them to preserve his vow and eternal fame.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a moonlit dream, the radiant Sun god appears as a Brahmana beside Karna sleeping on a rich bed and warns him of Indra’s coming deceit.
Karna stands resolute before the luminous figure of Surya, declaring he will give away even his life rather than break his vow of generosity.
The sun‑bright Surya pleads with Karna, whose divine armor and earrings gleam like molten gold upon his body in the darkness of night.
